newsitem.title: USA: News Corp declines comment on PrimeStar.
newsitem.headline: News Corp declines comment on PrimeStar.

text.p: News Corp Ltd declined comment on a Wall Street Journal report that it reached a tenative agreement to join PrimeStar Partners, a satellite-dish TV service owned by a group of cable operators.
The Journal cited sources close to the talks as saying News Corp would contribute the satellites it controls with MCI Communications Corp in return for a minority, non-voting stake in PrimeStar.
Rupert Murdoch's News Corp was able to cut a deal after PrimeStar's other partners lobbied Time Warner Inc. It comes shortly after News Corp's plan to acquire EchoStar Communications Corp collapsed.
However, the Journal said it was not certain that a final agreement will ever be reached between News and PrimeStar.
Among the terms still be resolved is how a new venture would be financed, as well as how to phase in new 18-inch dishes to customers now using PrimeStar's 36-inch dish, the paper said.
The tentative pact may be announced as early as this week, the Journal said.
Other PrimeStar partners include Tele-Communications Inc, U S West Media Group, Cox Communications Inc, and Comcast Corp.
